content: Isireli be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Dɑnuɔ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ sere n kɑ ɡirɑri Beri Sebɑɔ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑrɔ kɑ mɑɑ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Gɑlɑdin temɔ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ, bɑ mɛnnɑ bɑ nɔɔ tiɑ kuɑ nɡe tɔn turo Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ Misipɑɔ.
Ben bwese kɛrɑ bɑɑyeren wiruɡibu bɑ nɑwɑ dɔmɑ te. Ben tɑbu nɑɑnɑɑkobu be bɑ koo kpĩ bu kɑ tɑkobi sɑnnɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ nɛɛru (400.000).
N deemɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ bɑ nuɑ kɔ mɑ Isireli be bɑ tie bɑ mɛnnɛ Misipɑɔ. Mɑ Isireli be, bɑ bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ yenin bweseru yɑ kɑ koorɑ.
Mɑ Lefi wìn kurɔ bɑ ɡo mi, u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ nɛn kurɔ nɑɑ dɑwɑ sɑ wee. Mɑ sɑ tunumɑ Gibeɑɔ sɑ kpunɑ mi.
Yerɑ Gibeɑɡii be, bɑ mɑn seesi, bɑ nɑ bɑ mɑn tɑrusi diru mi nɑ kpĩ wɔ̃kuru. Nɛn tiiwɑ bɑ rɑɑ kɑsu bu kɑ kpunɑ bu ɡo ɑdɑmɑ nɑ bu nɛn kurɔ wɛ̃ mɑ bɑ kɑ nùn kpunɑ kɑ tilɑsi bɑ ɡo.
Yerɑ nɑ win ɡoo te suɑ nɑ bɔtirɑ nɑ Isirelin bwese kɛrɑ bɑɑyere kpiri tiɑ tiɑ mɔrisiɑ. Domi ɡɑ̃ɑ kɔ̃sunɑ bɑ kuɑ mi, nìn bweseru n ǹ weenɛ Isirelibɑ bu ko.
Yen sɔ̃, bɛɛ Isirelibɑ, wee i mɛnnɛ mini tɛ̃. I wesiɑnɔ kpɑ i ko ye n weenɛ i ko.
Mɑ be kpuro bɑ nɔɔ nɛrɑ nɡe tɔn turo. Bɑ nɛɛ, bɛsɛn ɡoo kun wurɔ win yɛnuɔ u sere nɛɛ u koo sinɑ win kuu bekuruɡirɔ.
Wee ye sɑ ko Gibeɑɡii be kuɑ. Sɑ ko tɛtɛ towɑ

su kɑ tɔmbu ɡɔsi Isirelin bwese kɛrɑ bɑɑyere sɔɔ. Tɔmbu wunɔbu (100) sɔɔ, sɑ ko wɔkuru wĩɑ. Tɔmbu nɔrɔbu (1.000) sɔɔ, sɑ ko wunɔbu wĩɑ. Tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ wɔkuru (10.000) sɔɔ, kpɑ su nɔrɔbu wĩɑ. Tɔn beyɑ bɑ koo dɑ bu sun dĩɑnu kɑsuɑmɑ su kɑ wɑ su di bɛsɛ be sɑ mɛnnɛ mini, kpɑ su wɑ su Gibeɑɡii be sɛɛyɑsiɑ ben dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ ye bɑ kuɑ min sɔ̃.
Nɡe mɛyɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ kɑ mɛnnɑ bɑ nɔɔ tiɑ kuɑ bu kɑ Gibeɑɡii be wɔri.
Mɑ Isireli be, bɑ tɔmbu ɡɔrɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn tem kpuro sɔɔ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ kɔ̃sɑ yenin bweseru yɑ kɑ koorɑ bɛɛn suunu sɔɔ mɛ.
Yen sɔ̃, i sun tɔn kɔ̃so be nɔmu sɔndio su bu ɡo, kpɑ su kɔ̃sɑ ye wunɑ bɛsɛ Isirelibɑn suunu sɔɔn di. Adɑmɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ be, bɑ yinɑ bu ben mɛro bisi ben ɡɑri nɔ.
Mɑ bɑ mɑɑ mɛnnɑ Gibeɑɔ bu kɑ Isirelibɑ tɑbu ko.
Yen dɔmɑ te, tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndɑ nɔɔbu kɑ tiɑ (26.000) be bɑ koo kpĩ bu kɑ tɑkobi sɑnnɑ, bɑ mɛnnɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn tem sɔɔ kɑ sere mɑɑ tɑbu durɔbu nɑtɑ kɑ wunɔbu (700) be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Gibeɑn tiiɡibu.
Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑn tɑbu durɔbu sɔɔ, ben nɑtɑ kɑ wunɔbu (700) bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɔm dwɑɑɡibu. Be kpuro bɑ nɔmɑ dowɑ ɡem ɡem. Domi ben ɡoo sɑri wi u koo tɔnun serɑ kpurɑntɛɛru yĩisi u kɔmiɑ.
Isirelibɑ sɔɔ mɑɑ, be bɑ tɑbun dɔɔnɛ mɔ bɑ koo kpĩ bu kɑ tɑkobi sɑnnɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ nɛɛru (400.000).
Mɑ Isireli be, bɑ dɑ Betɛliɔ bu kɑ Gusunɔ bikiɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔsi bwese kɛrɑ ye yɑ koo ɡbi yu Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ wɔri. Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Yudɑbɑ ɡɔsɑ.
Sisiru bururu Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ seewɑ bɑ ben sɑnsɑni ɡirɑ Gibeɑn bɔkuɔ.
Yen biru bɑ ben tɑbu sĩɑ yi Gibeɑn deedeeru bu kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ wɔri.
Yen dɔmɑ terɑ Gibeɑɡii be, bɑ yɑrimɑ bɑ Isirelibɑ wɔri bɑ ben tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndɑ yiru (22.000) ɡo.

Mɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ Gusunɔ weeweenu koosi sere n kɑ kuɑ yokɑ. Mɑ bɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bu mɑɑ ben mɛro bisi be wɔrio? Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, oo, bu doo. Sɑɑ yerɑ bɑ dɑm wɑ. Mɑ bɑ ben tɑbu sĩɑ kpĩ mi bɑ rɑɑ yellu kpĩ bɑ kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ be wɔri.
Yerɑ bɑ kpɑm Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ wɔri nɔn yiruse te.
Bɛnyɑmɛɛ be, bɑ kpɑm yɑrimɑ bɑ Isirelibɑn tɑbu durɔbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndu yiru sɑri ɡo (18.000).

Yerɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ mɛnnɑ Betɛliɔ bɑ sinɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yeru mi, bɑ weeweenu mɔ̀. Yen dɔmɑ te, bɑ nɔɔ bɔkuɑwɑ sere n kɑ kuɑ yokɑ. Mɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu kuɑ kɑ siɑrɑbun yɑ̃kunu.

N deemɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro te, tɑ wɑ̃ɑ Betɛli mi. Finɛɛsi, Eleɑsɑɑn bii, Aronin debubuwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃ku kowo sɑɑ ye. Yerɑ Isireli be, bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, su kpɑm Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ wɔrio? Mɑ u nɛɛ, oo, i doo. Kon bɛɛ bu nɔmu bɛriɑ siɑ.
Sɔ̃ɔ itɑse Isirelibɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ tɑbu sĩɑ kpĩ bu kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ wɔri nɡe mɛ bɑ rɑɑ kuɑ yellu. Adɑmɑ bɑ mɑɑ tɑbu kowobu beruɑ bɑ kɑ Gibeɑ sikerenɑ.

Yerɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ bɑ mɑɑ yɑrɑ bɑ kɑ Isireli be yinnɑ. Mɑ bɑ bu nɑɑ ɡirɑ bɑ kɑ wuu yɑrɑ bɑ tondɑ. Nɡe mɛ bɑ rɑɑ kuɑ bɑ kɑ Isirelibɑ ɡo yellu, nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ mɑɑ toruɑ mɑ bɑ mɑɑ ben tɔnu tɛnɑ ɡo Betɛlin swɑɑɔ kɑ Gibeɑɡiɑ sɔɔ yɑkɑsɔ.
Mɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ be, bɑ nɛɛ, wee, sɑ mɑɑ bu kɑmiɑ nɡe yellu. Adɑmɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ nɛɛ, i de su duki su kpɑ bu ben wuu deri bu tondɑ.
Mɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ mɛnnɑ Bɑɑli Tɑmɑɑɔ. Yerɑ be bɑ rɑɑ kukuɑ bɑ yɑrimɑ Mɑre Gebɑn di mi bɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ wɔkuru (10.000). Mɑ bɑ dɑ Gibeɑɔ bɑ tɑbu kuɑ ɡem ɡem kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ. Bɛnyɑmɛɛ be, bɑǹ yɛ̃ bɑ kɑm kobu dɔɔwɑ mi.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ bɑ burisinɑ Isirelibɑn wuswɑɑɔ. Yen dɔmɑ terɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ tɔmbu ɡo nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndɑ nɔɔbu kɑ wunɔbu (25.100) Bɛnyɑmɛɛn tɑbu kowobu sɔɔ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ bɑ tubɑ mɑ bɑ kɑm kuɑwɑ. Isirelibɑ bɑ rɑɑ duki suɑ bɑ bu deri yèn sɔ̃ bɑ yɛ̃ mɑ ben tɑbu kowobu ɡɑbɑ kukuɑ Gibeɑɔ bɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ mɑrɑ.
Berɑ bɑ yɑrimɑ bɑ Gibeɑ ye wɔri bɑ yen tɔmbu ɡo.
N deemɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ rɑɑ wesiɑnɑ bɑ nɛɛ, be bɑ kukuɑ mi, bu wuu ɡe dɔ̃ɔ sɔ̃reo, kpɑ be bɑ tie bu ɡɔsirɑmɑ bɑ̀ n wiisu wɑ.
Ye bɑ wii si wɑ, yerɑ bɑ ɡɔsirɑmɑ. Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ bɑ rɑɑ bu tɔmbu tɛnɑ ɡoori. Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ tɑmɑɑ bɑ mɑɑ bu kɑmiɑwɑ nɡe yellu.
Adɑmɑ sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, wii bɑkɑrɑ seewɑ sɑɑ Gibeɑn di, mɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ bɑ wɑ dɔ̃ɔ wiirɑ ben wuu wukiri mɑm mɑm.
Isireli be bɑ rɑɑ duki suɑ mi, bɑ ɡɔsirɑmɑ. Sɑɑ yerɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ be, bɑ nɑndɑ, domi bɑ wɑ wɔrɔ ye yɑ bu deemɑ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ duki suɑ bɑ doonɑ tem sɑɑrɑm berɑ ɡiɑ. Adɑmɑ Isireli be bɑ wuu ɡe dɔ̃ɔ sɔ̃re bɑ yɑrimɑ bɑ bu nɑɑ swĩi bɑ ɡoomɔ
sere Gibeɑn sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yerɔ. Bɑǹ wure Bɛnyɑmɛɛ be, bu yɔ̃rɑ bɑɑ fiiko bu sere wɛ̃rɑ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ kuɑ bɑ kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑn tɑbu durɔbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndu yiru sɑri (18.000) ye ɡo.
Bɑ mɑɑ ben tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ nɔɔbu (5.000) ɡo swɑɑ sɔɔ be bɑ duki mɔ̀ bɑ dɔɔ tem sɑɑrɑmɔ Rimɔɔn kperu ɡiɑ. Mɑ bɑ be bɑ tie nɑɑ swĩi sere Gideomuɔ. Miyɑ bɑ mɑɑ ben tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yiru (2.000) ɡo.
Be bɑ ɡu dɔmɑ te, ben bwese te sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑbu durɔbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndɑ nɔɔbu (25.000).
Adɑmɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ nɑtɑ (600) bɑ kpĩɑ bɑ turɑ Rimɔɔn kperu mi, tem sɑɑrɑmɔ mɑ bɑ kuɑ suru nnɛ berɑ mi.
Isirelibɑ bɑ ɡɔsirɑmɑ bɑ nɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ be bɑ tien wusu sɔɔ. Bɑ bu ɡo ɡo sere kɑ ben yɑɑ sɑbenɔ. Hunde koni ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi kpuro ɡesi, bɑ ɡowɑ. Mɑ bɑ ben wuu si kpuro dɔ̃ɔ mɛni.
Bɛnyɑmɛɛn bwese kɛrɑ
mɑɑ seewɑ
